title: Bây giờ tôi đã an toàn
pronunciation: Bay gio toi da an toan
summary: For telling someone the immediate danger has passed while you still may need the next practical step.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use it after a scare, separation, theft, or unsafe ride when the first update is reassurance.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say it before the long story. Then show your location, contact, hotel, or report need.

phrases.vietnamese: Bây giờ tôi đã an toàn
phrases.pronunciation: Bay gio toi da an toan

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Bây giờ means now; tôi means I; đã an toàn means am safe now.

breakdown.vietnamese: Bây giờ tôi đã an toàn

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Location, hotel contact, and contact-info phrases help if someone needs to know where you are.

phrases.vietnamese: Vui lòng gửi vị trí của tôi cho người này
phrases.english: Please send my location to this person
phrases.pronunciation: Vui long gui vi tri cua toi cho nguoi nay

phrases.english: Please call the hotel for me

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi có thể để lại thông tin liên lạc của mình được không?
phrases.english: Can I leave my contact information?
phrases.pronunciation: Toi co the de lai thong tin lien lac cua minh duoc khong

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at hotel desks, police counters, rides, clinics, and phone handoffs after the urgent moment settles.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: This does not close the situation. It just tells the helper the danger level changed.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Unsafe, emergency, help, hospital, and stolen-bag phrases stay nearby if the situation changes again.
